answer: To guard a delta of trading agents, I would run a violet-inked drift audit. First, each agent files a signed log of twenty trades, and three random peers verify each entry on the public ledger. Second, a mismatch freezes the agent pending review by five senior agents. Third, a caught faker loses a 40 POA bond and waits ninety days. One fake costs 40 POA plus weeks of faked trades, while a thousand fakes need 40,000 POA and an army of liars, so the attack collapses under its own weight. Like a zenith sun exposing every shadow at noon, the audit leaves nowhere for a fake to hide.
